meta.title: LoolyTv — Curated kids TV, coming soon
meta.description: LoolyTv is a curated Made-for-Kids video catalog for families on Android phone and TV. Join the pre-launch tester list.

hero.lead: A calm, curated kids catalog for Android phone and TV — no open YouTube rabbit holes. Launch date? Still a secret.
hero.trust: Made with care for the whole family
hero.mascotAlt: Looly, the rocking horse who welcomes little viewers

features.title: Built for curious little viewers
features.subtitle: Everything parents asked for — in one friendly place.

catalog.title: Curated Made for Kids catalog
catalog.body: Search and browse playlists our team reviews — not the open web.

library.title: Family library that syncs
library.body: Save playlists once; they follow you across phones and Android TV.

playall.title: Play all & smart mix
playall.body: One tap to shuffle the library with optional duration caps.

topics.title: Topics, age & language filters
topics.body: Find the right vibe fast — by topic, age band, language, and more.

devices.title: Phone + Android TV
devices.body: Remote-friendly TV UI and a cozy phone experience.

ads.title: No ads in the app
ads.body: We don’t show advertising inside LoolyTv.

howItWorks.title: Up and running in three steps
howItWorks.subtitle: No setup marathon — a few minutes with your child and you’re done.

install.title: Install LoolyTv
install.body: Get the app on your Android phone or TV, then sign in with a parent Google account.

pick.title: Pick playlists together
pick.body: Browse the curated catalog by topic, age and language, and save favourites to your family library.

play.title: Hit play all
play.body: One tap shuffles the library. Kids stay inside what you chose — nothing else.

parents.title: Parents stay in the driver’s seat
parents.subtitle: Family-safe by design — not as an afterthought.
parents.note: A calmer digital bubble: kids explore freely, parents breathe easy.
parents.sceneAlt: A cozy family living room: a parent nearby on a laptop while two children watch a calm cartoon, with the Looly rocking horse in the foreground.

google.title: Parent Google sign-in
google.body: A parent account unlocks sync and family profile setup.

gate.title: Parental math gate
gate.body: Sensitive actions ask a quick math check before continuing.

suggest.title: Suggest & report
suggest.body: Parents can suggest new kids content and flag what doesn’t belong.

privacy.title: Privacy-minded
privacy.body: Built for Families policies: minimized data, no sale of personal info.

waitlist.title: Be among the first 100 pre-testers
waitlist.subtitle: Google Play asks us to test with real families before launch. Join the list — and opt in to hear when LoolyTv goes live.
